scope: Independent implementation, external-shape, proxy-scatter and public-data null controls for the publication wake forecast. These tests validate the pipeline and robustness; they are not observational detection claims.

independent_two_tracer_fisher_identity.interpretation: The independent analytic two-tracer Fisher expression agrees with the full covariance implementation to numerical precision across randomized positive-definite test cases.

published_wake_benchmark.published_reference: Ge, Pasquini & Tan DESI-BGS halo-mass split shape control
published_wake_benchmark.interpretation: After one normalization at log10 Msplit=13.75, the remaining threshold dependence reproduces the published optimum and the 12.75 anchor to 6.16%. The Okoli Eq. 35 rows are calibration identities.

halo_mass_proxy_scatter.interpretation: A 0.2 dex mass-observable scatter reduces the projected S/N by about 2.6% and retains about 94.9% of the zero-scatter Fisher information.

desi_dr1_parity_odd_null.catalog: DESI DR1 Gfinder group VAC: DESIDR9.y1.v1_group.fits
desi_dr1_parity_odd_null.scope: End-to-end public-data parity-odd null/smoke test only; not a DESI LSS wake likelihood.
desi_dr1_parity_odd_null.interpretation: The estimator is statistically consistent with the permutation null on public DESI-linked data and does not generate a spurious large parity-odd signal in this smoke test.
